name: Anata to Kozukuri Shitai na♪ ~Suujuunen Buri no Saikai! Osananajimi wa Eroku Yokkyuu Fuman ni Natteimashita~
original_name: あなたと子作りしたいな♪～数十年振りの再会！幼馴染はエロく欲求不満になっていました～
source:
Toshiro is a totally ordinary office worker blessed with a wife and child.
One day, he receives word that his mother has suddenly passed away, and he returns to his hometown with his family.
When he gets there, it turns out that his father got ahead of himself, and his mother is very much still alive.
Since he came all the way there, he decides to stay with his family for a little while to visit.

While there, he happens to run into his childhood friend, Akiho.
Despite how long it's been, their friendship is rekindled instantly, and when the conversation heads in a dirty direction, Akiho says something shocking.

Hey, it's been a while, so why don't you show me something nice? It'll be fun.
You showed it to me before, so it should be no problem, right? I bet it's pretty hard!

It's true that they used to show each other their genitals as a joke.
But that was just because they were too young to know any better.

You had too much to drink, didn't you? Here, I'll take you back to your place, so let's go.

Since Akiho seems to be pretty drunk, she won't listen to Toshiro's attempts to calm her down…

translation:
俊郎是一名再普通不过的上班族，有妻有子，家庭幸福。
某天，他突然接到母亲去世的消息，便带着家人赶回故乡。
到了才发现，原来是父亲误会了情况，母亲其实还好好活着。
既然难得回来一趟，他便决定与家人多住几天，探望亲人。

期间，他偶然重逢了儿时玩伴晶穗。
虽然已许久不见，两人却立刻找回了往日的亲近。可当话题逐渐变得暧昧时，晶穗却说出了惊人之语。

“喂，难得这么久没见，让我看看好东西嘛。会很有意思的。
以前你也给我看过，没关系吧？我猜现在一定很硬呢！”

确实，小时候两人曾把互相展示私处当作玩笑。
但那只是因为当时年幼无知。

“你喝多了吧？来，我送你回家，走吧。”

晶穗似乎醉得厉害，根本听不进俊郎的劝说……
